title: PUT /books/{id} is full-replace, not partial update
evidence: src/main/java/books/BookController.java:49-52 and BookRepository.java:46-51 overwrite year/isbn with null when omitted (tested at src/test/java/books/BookApiTest.java:62-69)
suggestion: Acceptable PUT semantics; note it is replace-not-merge. No change required.
